script_text: Stop everything, Taurus, because the universe will violently shake your very own Earth foundation this week. As the Sun moves into your 11th House of community, the Saturn square eases significantly. This allows collaborative projects to flourish, bringing unexpected monetary rewards by the weekend. Friday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of pleasure. Monday is your worst day because Saturn squares your natal Sun in the 1st House. You must protect your energy by saying no to unnecessary drama this week. Follow for daily updates.
